headline: UHS Q2 Deep Dive: Acute Care Growth and Outpatient Initiatives Shape Outlook
summary: Hospital management company Universal Health Services (NYSE:UHS) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 8.3% year on year to $4.64 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $18.63 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.98 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
